title: Using `select(Model).from_statement(stmt)` no longer works when `stmt` contains a labeled column

labels.name: regression
labels.description: something worked and was broken by a change

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
### Describe the bug

When attempting to use `select(Model).from_statement(stmt)` where `stmt` is selecting from a subquery, running a function on one of the subquery's columns, and labeling the result of that function, the ORM sets the labeled column as deferred and tries to refresh.

### To Reproduce

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio

from sqlalchemy import Computed, Text, func, select, text as _sa_text
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import TSVECTOR
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, create_async_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, MappedAsDataclass, mapped_column


class Base(MappedAsDataclass, DeclarativeBase):
    ...


class Section(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'sections'

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True, init=False)
    text: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text)
    search_vector: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        TSVECTOR, Computed(func.to_tsvector(_sa_text("'english'"), func.trim(text))), init=False
    )


engine = create_async_engine(
    "postgresql+asyncpg://user:xxxxxx@localhost/dbname", echo=True
)


async def main() -> None:
    async with AsyncSession(engine) as session:
        session.add(Section(text='faith'))
        await session.flush()
        tsquery = func.plainto_tsquery(_sa_text("'english'"), 'faith')
        section_query = (
            select(Section)
            .filter(
                Section.search_vector.bool_op('@@')(tsquery),
            )
            .subquery()
        )
        headline_query = select(
            section_query.c.id,
            func.ts_headline(
                _sa_text("'english'"),
                section_query.c.text,
                tsquery,
                _sa_text("'StartSel=**, StopSel=**'"),
            ).label('text'),
            section_query.c.search_vector,
        )
        aliased_query = select(Section).from_statement(headline_query)

        result = await session.scalars(aliased_query)

        print(list(result))


asyncio.run(main())
```
